title: async/await, Tokio, TCP & HTTP
objectives: Explain async/await as state machines on an executor
Use tokio::time and tokio::net for timeouts and TCP
Recognize where reqwest fits for HTTP clients

examples.name: std_threads_as_async_stands.rs

exercise.prompt: Simulate a 5-second-style timeout: implement `with_deadline(limit_ms, work_ms) -> &'static str` returning "done" when work ≤ limit else "timeout", printing both cases (limit 50, work 30 / work 120).
hints: Compare durations instead of sleeping long: if work_ms <= limit_ms return "done".
(Optional) actually sleep work_ms capped at limit via std::thread::sleep.
